brief:
Partial results released by Israel's Central Elections Committee show the pro-Netanyahu bloc has secured 59 seats, according to Middle East Eye. The anti-Netanyahu bloc won 46 seats in the count released so far.

The results reflect voting across portions of Israel's electorate, with the full count still underway. The 120-seat Knesset requires a governing coalition to command at least 61 seats.
dek: Netanyahu gains 59 seats in partial Israeli election results Partial results published by the Central Elections Committee show that the pro-Netanyahu bloc has gained 59 seats in contrast to 46 seats for the anti-Netanyahu bloc 46.
title: Netanyahu bloc gains 59 seats in partial Israeli election count
